description: Machine-runnable mirror of signoff-checklist.md. Drives the real Advanced Paste window via winappcli; paste checks verify the text Advanced Paste pastes into a target Notepad (winapp ui get-value). Requires synthetic input (SendInput) to be healthy and the ap_controller.ps1 ShowUI pipe + a Notepad target running. See SKILL.md > App-Specific winappcli Logic.
notes: winappcli has no type/clipboard verb; clipboard is set out-of-band (set_clipboard.ps1) and the paste is performed by Advanced Paste itself via SendInput(Ctrl+V). These checks are therefore executed by run_signoff.ps1, not by signoff.py's generic runner. This spec documents the intent and priorities.

checks.capability: Paste as plain text returns clipboard text and strips HTML tags
Paste as markdown converts HTML <h1> heading to '# Title'
Paste as JSON converts CSV to a JSON array (values preserved)
Paste as JSON converts XML to a JSON object with element keys
Paste as JSON returns already-valid JSON unchanged (passthrough)
Paste as JSON falls back to a JSON array-of-lines for non-tabular text (never-throws guard)
AI prompt box (InputTxtBox) is disabled when no AI provider is configured (AI gating)
Window clipboard preview shows the current clipboard content
Core paste-format list shows plain text, markdown and JSON actions
Paste as markdown converts bold to '**bold**' emphasis
